en.html:
About to run through a little backstreet crossroads, I stopped.

A pedestrian’s back was visible to my left.

Nothing remarkable in that alone. Ordinary clothes, an ordinary townsman. His movements, however, were peculiar.

He swayed drunkenly, right and left, occasionally <ruby>tripping<rt>stumbling</rt></ruby>. Normally I would have dismissed him as drunk and gone on.

But soldiers controlled the town now. Citizens were hardly in a position to wander tipsily about in <ruby>a mellow haze<rt>pleasant intoxication</rt></ruby>.

Then... what was this?

While I hesitated over calling to him, something else entered my view.

A car.

Unlike the vehicles wealthy people of this age used within and between towns. Something normally absent from these streets.

A military car, open-topped, with two foreign soldiers.

The street was narrow. To avoid such a large vehicle, a pedestrian would almost have to flatten himself against the wall.

No difficult action, surely. Yet the staggering man seemed unable even to manage that.

He apparently noticed the car approaching directly, but his movements remained slow. Drunk after all? His body seemed beyond his proper control.

At that rate, the car would—
